institutions: Institute for Particle Physics Phenomenology, Durham University

parameters.name: VeN
parameters.description: Active-heavy mixing V_eN (real); paper sigma0 sets |V|=1, Eq.(Lagrangian)

parameters.name: VmN
parameters.description: Active-heavy mixing V_muN (real); paper sigma0 sets |V|=1, Eq.(Lagrangian)

parameters.name: VtN
parameters.description: Active-heavy mixing V_tauN (real); paper sigma0 sets |V|=1, Eq.(Lagrangian)

lagrangian_terms.name: LWN
lagrangian_terms.expression: -gw/Sqrt[2] W[mu] (VeN bar[CC[Nr]].Ga[mu].ProjP.l[1] + VmN bar[CC[Nr]].Ga[mu].ProjP.l[2] + VtN bar[CC[Nr]].Ga[mu].ProjP.l[3]) + HC[-gw/Sqrt[2] W[mu] (VeN bar[CC[Nr]].Ga[mu].ProjP.l[1] + VmN bar[CC[Nr]].Ga[mu].ProjP.l[2] + VtN bar[CC[Nr]].Ga[mu].ProjP.l[3])]

lagrangian_terms.name: LZN
lagrangian_terms.expression: -gw/(2 cw) Z[mu] (VeN bar[CC[Nr]].Ga[mu].ProjP.vl[1] + VmN bar[CC[Nr]].Ga[mu].ProjP.vl[2] + VtN bar[CC[Nr]].Ga[mu].ProjP.vl[3]) + HC[-gw/(2 cw) Z[mu] (VeN bar[CC[Nr]].Ga[mu].ProjP.vl[1] + VmN bar[CC[Nr]].Ga[mu].ProjP.vl[2] + VtN bar[CC[Nr]].Ga[mu].ProjP.vl[3])]

lagrangian_terms.name: LhN
lagrangian_terms.expression: -gw MN/(2 MW) H (VeN bar[CC[Nr]].ProjP.vl[1] + VmN bar[CC[Nr]].ProjP.vl[2] + VtN bar[CC[Nr]].ProjP.vl[3]) + HC[-gw MN/(2 MW) H (VeN bar[CC[Nr]].ProjP.vl[1] + VmN bar[CC[Nr]].ProjP.vl[2] + VtN bar[CC[Nr]].ProjP.vl[3])]
